blind.description: No text or labels are visible in any of the images. The model is a tall, free-standing architectural stone pillar (column) wrapped by an octopus tentacle. It features a stepped square plinth base, a central vertical square column shaft decorated with recessed pointed Gothic arches, and a stepped square capital with a flat top. A thick violet/purple tentacle with light pink circular suction cups coils spirally upward around the shaft from the base, with its upper portion gripping and curling over the top rim of the capital. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean, with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing hovers unattached, and there is no melted or poorly fused geometry. The pillar stands directly on its own integrated stepped square base with a flat underside sitting flush on the floor; there is no added slab, disc, or separate plinth. Materials and colors consist of stylized hand-painted textures featuring pale mauve and lavender-grey stone with darker shading in crevices and faint cracks on the capital, and a rich purple tentacle with pale pink suckers. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), the model displays the flat square top of the pillar's capital in light lavender-grey stone, featuring subtle diagonal crack markings. The rounded violet masses of the tentacle grip and protrude slightly past the edges on opposite sides, with one fleshy tip curling onto the top-right corner and another loop bulging along the lower-left edge. The pillar casts a clear directional shadow toward the upper-right of the frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: The model is approximately 10 feet tall (about 1.7 to 1.8 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, which reaches only up to the mid-shaft). The square base and capital are approximately 3.1 to 3.2 feet wide (about 0.55 times the height of the figure, spanning roughly two-thirds of a 5-foot floor grid square).
